# Guardion

> Guardion is an Australian specialist protection and investigations firm. We provide close protection and lawful private investigations for high-net-worth individuals, executives, family offices and organisations. Licensed across QLD, NSW, ACT, VIC and SA; coordinating internationally through vetted local partners.

Positioning: Protection & Intelligence — end to end.
